transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I’ve been hearing things, and I know that probably sounds bad. It’s mostly at work — like people talking about me through the conference room walls, or sometimes from my phone even when it’s off.

It sounds very clear, like board members or staff saying I’m ruining the company. I try not to make a big deal out of it, but sometimes I answer them before I realize no one else heard anything. Is that… the kind of thing you need to know?
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?

Um… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had busy stretches where I pushed through on less sleep because of work, but not like I felt unusually energized or didn’t need it. I’m pretty sure I still felt tired. Is that what you mean?
Do you believe people are actually trying to harm you or sabotage you?

I… don’t know that I’d say harm me, exactly. Sabotage sounds… strong. I mean, I’ve wondered if people are working against me sometimes, but I try not to assume the worst. I don’t want to sound paranoid or unfair. Does that make sense?
Apart from the voices, have you been seeing things that other people don’t seem to see?

No, I don’t think I’ve been seeing things like that. It’s more… hearing people, mostly. Like at work, through the conference room walls, or from my phone when it’s off. It sounds so real that I’ll sometimes answer before I realize no one else heard it.
Have these voices been happening for longer than one month?

Yeah… I guess it has been longer than a month. I was hoping it was just a short stressful thing, but the voices from the walls or my phone have been happening for about three months now. Is that… the kind of timeframe you mean?
During these past three months, have you had a period of feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

I’m not sure I’d call it depressed like that. I mean, I’ve had low days and I’ve been worn down, but most of the day nearly every day for two weeks… I don’t think so? At least not that I’ve noticed in that clear a way. Is that the kind of distinction you’re asking about?
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological condition that started before these voices began?
No… not that I know of. I mean, I’ve had the usual checkups and things, but no one’s told me I have some medical or neurological condition that started before all this. Is that what you mean?
Do you believe for certain that specific people at work are deliberately plotting against you?

I don’t know that I’d say “for certain.” I mean… work has been tense, and sometimes I worry people aren’t being straight with me, but saying they’re deliberately plotting against me feels like a strong way to put it. I’m not sure I have proof of that. Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?
Do you have a firm belief that someone is spying on you or trying to ruin your reputation?

I wouldn’t say I have a firm belief, no. Sometimes I get uneasy and wonder how people are talking about me, but “spying on me” or “trying to ruin my reputation” sounds… stronger than what I can honestly say. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. Does that answer it okay?
Before the voices started, had you been using any drugs or taking any new medication?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I wasn’t using drugs, and I don’t remember starting any new medication before it began. At least nothing that stands out to me. Is that helpful?
Since the voices began, have you found yourself caring much less about things or having much less motivation to do your usual activities?

Yes… I think so. I don’t like admitting that, because I’ve always been very driven. I used to be the one pushing every idea forward, calling people after openings, keeping everything moving.

Now I can sit at my desk for hours just staring at the agenda and not really doing anything. I barely talk to my husband or my staff sometimes, and the strange part is I don’t even feel much about work anymore, even though I used to love it. I’m trying not to make it sound dramatic, but… yes, my motivation has really dropped. Is that what you mean?
